dependency: Task 188 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 195 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No coordinates, polygons, footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: South Quay Plaza
features.official_source_evidence: Berkeley Group is the primary developer source for South Quay Plaza and markets new homes within the Canary Wharf development.
features.classification_finding: Residential use is supported, but South Quay Plaza is a multi-tower development. A named tower such as Hampton Tower must be selected before a single Apartment Building footprint can be bound.

features.name: Ickworth House
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust is the authoritative property source for Ickworth House, Park and Gardens in Suffolk.
features.classification_finding: The principal standalone house is supported, but the tracked property includes park, gardens and current visitor use. The main house must be isolated and the residential Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.

features.name: SEVEN at Southbank Place
features.official_source_evidence: The official Southbank Place site identifies SEVEN as a residential building containing 92 residences.
features.classification_finding: Apartment Building is strongly supported for the named SEVEN building. Exact building-footprint evidence remains pending.

features.name: Embassy Gardens
features.official_source_evidence: Embassy Gardens is retained as the primary development domain, but automated access currently presents a verification challenge.
features.classification_finding: The tracked name describes a broad residential and commercial development containing multiple buildings. One named residential building must be selected before Apartment Building geometry binding.

features.name: One Canada Square
features.official_source_evidence: Canary Wharf Group is the estate owner and authoritative portfolio source for One Canada Square; current commercial occupancy evidence continues to support office use.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. The tower footprint must be isolated from the surrounding Canada Square retail and estate areas.

features.name: 70 St Mary Axe
features.official_source_evidence: The official building site presents 70 St Mary Axe as a business building with workspaces, office floorplans and office specifications.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is directly supported. Exact building and parcel footprint evidence remains pending.
